name: counterseal
description: Holds a coding agent's irreversible shell commands (terraform destroy, git push --force, DROP TABLE, rm -rf outside the project and more) until you approve them with a passkey. A seatbelt, not a sandbox.

tokens.title: Counterseal proxy tokens (optional)
tokens.description: Only for the Counterseal MCP server: provider=token pairs separated by commas, for example github=lsh_..., stripe=lsh_.... Leave empty if you only want the guard.
